title: Physio Weekly for Sabaa: November 1, 2026
description: Welcome to this week's research roundup for Sabaa. We have a substantial batch of new evidence to cover, spanning pharmacology, neurorehabilitation, orthopedics, and digital health. Let's start with the scientific literature. A new Cochrane systematic review has tackled a long-standing question in stroke rehabilitation: whether levodopa or dopamine agonists can enhance motor recovery when combined
